briefing.headline: MSGE rockets 29.5% as small‑cap surge fuels overnight rally
briefing.summary: Core mega‑cap tech stocks showed modest moves, with most edging slightly higher while a few slipped, resulting in a net bullish bias among the large caps. Breadth was positive (7 advancers vs 3 decliners) but the standout action came from small‑cap tokens, led by MSGE (+29.5%), CTBI (+26.6%) and SLDB (+23%). The overall market displayed mixed sentiment as the rally in high‑growth names was offset by a sharp drop in SSPC (-18.6%).

macro_context.detail: Small‑cap tokens posted the strongest gains, highlighting a shift of capital into higher‑risk names.
